initial_setup.note: **Alice** comes equipped with a **Small Bible**, a **Cotton Blouse**, and a **Bandanna** by default, and also comes with the **Pendant** valuable.

objectives: Collect the **Pure Leaf** and **Leather Belt** before reuniting with **Alice**
Meet the girl, confirm default character names (**Yuri** & **Alice**), and have **Alice** join the party
Examine the locked sluice gate, then go back to the last fork and use the **Save Point** to the southeast
Retrieve the **Sluice Gate Handle** via either the Southern ('**Push Ring**') or Northern ('**Normal Ring**') mini-game
Lower the water with the sluice gate, rest, and endure the battle against **Fox Face**
In the **Graveyard**, defeat sub-boss **Raging Tiger** to obtain **Yuri**'s **Earth** Fusion (**Tigerion**)
Converse with the **Masks** and defeat **Evil 4** to purge **Yuri**'s accumulated Malice
Open the chest below the bridge and collect the **Holy Mother Bust**

bosses.name: Raging Tiger
bosses.strategy:
Hey, we can win this one!

- Go ahead and use **Yuri**'s Fusion skill to become the **Death Emperor**, then use normal attacks to wipe out the **Raging Tiger**.
- He's not tough at all, and should take just a couple turns to take out.

callouts.title: Malice and The Graveyard System
callouts.text:
The Talisman Yuri holds shows the level of Malice accumulated in his soul.

- Each enemy defeated increases the Malice Meter.
- Make sure Yuri's Malice level (found in the menu) does NOT reach the red.
- If it does, IMMEDIATELY go to the Graveyard and fight your Malice so that you don't fight Fox Face.
- Right now, you WILL die if you try to fight Fox Face, so if you run into him, press the R1 button and choose to Run Away.
- Return to the Graveyard whenever Malice builds up to fight Malice incarnates (Evil 1 through Evil 4) and purge it safely.

callouts.title: Soul Energy & Fusions
callouts.text:
- The Soul Energy results screen appears after battles, displaying points required to level up each fusion element class.
- Once an element class levels up, visit the Graveyard and examine glowing gravestones to obtain new Level 1 Fusions (Level 2 Fusions unlock later in the story).

callouts.title: Internal Malice Point Tracking
callouts.text:
- The only issue with this is that it's a number the system tracks that you cannot see.
- The levels change at 25/50/75/100.
- The early monsters seem to contribute 1 point each toward the total, and it seems that as you go through the game, the stronger monsters give more points.
- It's something you kind of have to guess point values as you go; it's more of a guideline than anything, since it just shows what's possible to get by doing so.

steps.description:
1. After some dialogue, you'll regain control.
2. Take a few steps to the upper-left to find a **Pure Leaf** on the ground, then head down to the next area.

1. Instead of following the path, go right into the grass and to the next area, where you'll find a chest containing a **Leather Belt**.
2. Go ahead and equip this to the **Rude Hero**.

1. Head back and follow the path west until you find the girl.
2. This will allow you to continue the dialogue, where you'll be able to name your characters.
3. The default names are **Yuri** for the **Rude Hero** and **Alice** for the **Girl In Danger**, and I will be referring to them by their default names throughout the guide.
4. **Alice** will join your party, and you'll regain control.

notes.title: Alice's Starting Equipment
notes.text: **Alice** comes equipped with a **Small Bible**, a **Cotton Blouse**, and a **Bandanna** by default, and also comes with the **Pendant** valuable.

steps.description:
1. Start to head southeast and examine the body of water to your south.
2. You can't cross it yet, so take a few steps southeast.
3. Before stepping on the bridge, look just below where you're standing to find a **Mermaid's Tear**.
Continue southeast to the next area, where **Alice** notes that we need to do something with the **sluice gate** to keep going, so that's our next task.

1. Before doing that, head north to the fork, then go east and past the fork here, following the path as it turns north and west to another **sluice gate**.
2. Examine it to find out that you need a handle to use it.
3. Now go back to the last fork and use the **Save Point** to the southeast to save, that way if you accidentally mess up the next task, you can reload and retry it.

description.text: In any case, there are two ways to handle this next task; read them both before deciding which one to try:

items.text: Examine the sparkling **Sluice Gate** handle at the bottom part of the screen.

You'll have to do a "Push Ring" to be able to get the handle, meaning that you have to push the `CROSS` button several times in order to get the indicator within the allowed range, then press it intermittently to keep it in that area until the time expires.
Doing this successfully the first time will not only net you the handle, but also a **Leather Belt** (raises Attack) here after a sequence of events.
If you fail the first time, but succeed the second, you'll receive a **Thera Seed**.
If you succeed the third or any time after, you'll receive a **Thera Leaf**.
Examine the sparkling **Sluice Gate** handle at the top part of the screen.
You'll have to do a "Normal Ring" to be able to get the handle, meaning that you have to push the `CROSS` button three times when the indicator is within the allowed ranges, just like in battle.
Doing this successfully the first time will not only net you the handle, but also a **Bandanna** (raises Defense) here after a sequence of events.
If you fail the first time, but succeed the second, you'll receive a **Mana Seed**.
If you succeed the third or any time after, you'll receive a **Mana Leaf**.

notes.title: Source discrepancy: Mana Leaf here vs Thera Leaf in the chest list (step 13), northern gate, third or more tries
notes.text:
- If you succeed the third or any time after, you'll receive a **Mana Leaf**.
- A **Thera Leaf** if you got the northern gate's handle the third or more tries.

steps.description:
1. Regardless of how you decided to get it, you'll receive the **Sluice Gate Handle**.
2. Head back to the northeastern side of this area and use the **Sluice Gate Handle** on the **Sluice Gate** to lower the water running through the plain.

1. Start to make your way back to the previous area, and they'll decide to take a rest for a while.
2. Shortly after **Alice** falls asleep, a mysterious figure known as **Fox Face** will appear, and you'll have to fight him in battle.

notes.title: Unwinnable Confrontation
notes.text: Once again, it's impossible to win this battle, so feel free to just wail away at him until he uses the !!! attack to reduce your HP to 1, followed by being knocked out once again.

steps.description:
1. After the battle, you'll be in the **Graveyard**, the one in **Yuri**'s dreams.
2. When you gain control, head north and examine the glowing green tombstone to be thrown into a battle, this time with the **Raging Tiger**.
3. By defeating him in battle, **Yuri** can now equip the soul of **Raging Tiger**, Tigerion!
4. Be sure to equip it in the menu.

1. Next, head west and talk to the **Masks** here, who'll tell you that you need to defeat the accumulation of **Malice** within you to be able to leave the **Graveyard**.
2. You'll then enter a battle with **Evil 4**.
3. He's pretty easy; just fuse into the **Raging Tiger** and dish out some strong hits to take him out in a turn or two.

notes.title: What the Masks said
notes.text:
To sum up everything that the Masks have said:

- The **Talisman** **Yuri** holds will show the level of **Malice** that has accumulated in his soul.
- To rid himself of the **Malice**, he must return to the **Graveyard** and fight an incarnate of his **Malice** to keep from having to face **Fox Face** in battle.
- Each enemy you defeat will increase the **Malice Meter**, so make sure that your **Malice** level (found in the menu) does NOT reach the red.
- If it does, IMMEDIATELY go to the **Graveyard** and fight your **Malice** so that you don't fight **Fox Face**.
- Right now, you WILL die if you try to fight him, so if you run into him, press the `R1` button and choose to Run Away.

notes.title: Soul Energy
notes.text:
- You also will now see the **Soul Energy** screen after battle.
- It shows you how many points away you are from leveling up a class.
- Once a class is leveled, you can visit the **Graveyard** and obtain a new Fusion by examining the glowing gravestones (but only up to level 1 Fusions for now; level 2 will be available later in the game.)
- If you're confused about how **Malice** and the **Graveyard** work, check out the Help section in the menu for a full explanation.

steps.description: Once you're done with the Masks, head east and back out into the real world, where **Alice** will rejoin and you'll regain control.

notes.title: Graveyard re-fights
notes.text:
You can fight **Evil 1**, **Evil 2**, **Evil 3**, and even **Evil 4** again by returning to the **Graveyard** and fighting them when your **Malice** level is at a certain color:

- **Evil 1**: Between Blue and Turquoise.
- **Evil 2**: Between Turquoise and Green.
- **Evil 3**: Between Green and Yellow.
- **Evil 4**: Between Yellow and Red.
- After each battle, you'll receive an item based on your **Malice**!

notes.title: Malice prize rules
notes.text:
- The prize you win depends on the level of **Malice** you have accumulated, with 100 being the max value.
- Sadly you can't use this knowledge to get the special prizes again and again, as they are replaced with a **Thera Leaf** the second time you clear the **Malice** at the same value.

notes.title: Malice value is hidden
notes.text:
- The only issue with this is that it's a number the system tracks that you cannot see.
- The levels change at 25/50/75/100, and the early monsters seem to contribute 1 point each toward the total, and it seems that as you go through the game, the stronger monsters give more points.
- It's something you kind of have to guess point values as you go; it's more of a guideline than anything, since it just shows what's possible to get by doing so.

description.text: From the **Save Point**, make your way back to the screen with the bridge and the river. There will be a chest here down below the bridge; open it to receive one of the following:

items.text: A **Leather Belt** if you got the southern gate's handle the first try.
A **Thera Seed** if you got the southern gate's handle the second try.
A **Thera Leaf** if you got the southern gate's handle the third or more tries.
A **Bandanna** if you got the northern gate's handle the first try.
A **Mana Seed** if you got the northern gate's handle the second try.
A **Thera Leaf** if you got the northern gate's handle the third or more tries.

steps.description:
1. Once you have your treasure, head back across the bridge, then cross the river bank to the southwest and follow the path to the next area.
2. Take a few steps to the left for an event, then open the chest to your northwest when you regain control for a **Holy Mother Bust**.
3. Continue to the village gates, where you'll be able to enter after some short discussion.
